commit_message: Complete ADR 0126 Timeline Sequencer first release
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0126 Timeline / Sequencer first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0126 Timeline / Sequencer against current main, superseding the stale/conflicted implementation in #613.

- ports the neutral Timeline schema, authoring service, production runtime composition, and Project Rust boundary to current main
- drives Sequencer transport through the persistent Scene View PreviewWorld using the production Timeline evaluator and domain systems
- adds searchable typed Animation Set/MotionSlot, Audio, and VFX clip authoring without fake Stable IDs
- integrates Timeline working copies with Save All, project switching, external-file coherency, Sequencer close, and native Editor shutdown
- centralizes atomic Timeline asset + manifest creation in the existing asset-management rollback boundary
- preserves ReplayRequired / NonSeekable semantics and suppresses event side effects during scrub/seek

This PR remains Draft and is intended to replace #613 after validation.
